name: armd-models-v0.9
status: interim: XGBoost final; logistic, MLP ensemble and Bayesian models from an earlier run on an earlier version of the feature tables, evaluated on the current tables; superseded by armd-models-v1
target: P(susceptible) of the first isolate in a culture order to the named drug
training_data: ARMD, three public sites (stanford, ecuh, utsw); patient-grouped 60/20/20 split; metrics are on the pooled test split
statistics:
Each exported model (the files in the release, not the training objects) is run on the pooled test split of its
cell. Point estimates are on the whole test split; 95% intervals are percentile intervals from a bootstrap that
resamples patients (a patient's culture orders stay together). All models in a cell share the same resamples, so
differences between models are paired.

Statistics (positive class: susceptible, as in ARMD-Predict):
  auroc, auprc, spec90 (specificity at 90% sensitivity), brier, ece (10 equal-width bins),
  cal_slope and cal_intercept (logistic recalibration y ~ a + b logit(p); ideal 1 and 0),
  oe_ratio (observed / expected susceptible), auroc_vs_xgboost_shared (paired difference).
Per site: AUROC with its interval. For models with draws: mean sd of the draws and mean width of the 90% interval.
